## Modron - `1.2.15`

- Adds content from [*Single-Class Synergy, Volume 3: Higher Callings*](https://www.drivethrurpg.com/en/product/530315/single-class-synergy-volume-3-higher-callings-a5e?affiliate_id=1388381)
- Adds in-system Changelog journal and workflow (WIP)
- Adds Monster Feature to feature types
- Adds Monster Features to compendium browser
- Adds Monster Feature compendium

### Fixes
- Fixes description for Channel Divinity: Turn Undead
- Fixes paragon grant for Half-Giant
